name: Tarrant County Tax Assessor-Collector
notes: Researched from public tarrantcountytx.gov pages only. Online and phone (817-884-1110, 24/7) card fees: credit 2.15%, debit $2.95 flat; in person credit 2.15% ($2.50 minimum) and debit $2.50 (flat/minimum fees not expressible). eCheck fee not stated (bank fee left at default 0). Taxes delinquent February 1; last day without penalty January 31 (online/phone by 11:59 p.m. CST, mail postmarked). Half Payment option (first half by Nov 30, second by June 30) and quarterly installments for over-65/disabled homesteads (Jan 31, Mar 31, May 31, Jul 31). Paperless billing: search account, choose PAPERLESS, agree, enter email; mailed bills and delinquent notices stop; UNSUBSCRIBE to stop. No automatic payment program is described. Penalty/interest schedule not on pages read. Review 2026-10-09: statements label is the real 'Print Statement'; 'Installment Options' was not a label on the site, so the nav link is a plain description. Review 2 (2026-10-09): the new tax portal (tax.tarrantcountytx.gov) has an optional TaxPayer Portal login (Email address + Password, Reset password, Sign up, Google/Facebook/Microsoft), so auth is observed_public and labels follow it; paying needs no profile (guest search by account, owner or address). Contact set to the tax office line (817) 884-1100. The eCheck fee is still not published.

public.label: Where, When and How to Pay

guest_pay.note: No profile or login is needed: search by account number, owner name or address, add the account to the cart and pay online 24/7.

paperless.note: Choose PAPERLESS on your account, accept the terms and enter an email; mailed bills and delinquent notices stop.

autopay.note: There is no automatic payment program. Pay online, by phone, by mail or at a branch, or use the Half Payment or quarterly installment options.

pay_by_phone.note: 24/7 in English or Spanish; same fees as online.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail to P.O. Box 961018, Fort Worth, TX 76161-0018, postmarked by January 31.

importantDates: Tax statements are mailed in October and are due on receipt.
January 31 is the last day to pay without penalty and interest; online and phone payments must be finished by 11:59 p.m. Central time, mailed payments postmarked by January 31.
Unpaid taxes become delinquent on February 1.

help.title: Where, when and how to pay
paragraphs: Taxes become delinquent February 1, so January 31 is the last day to pay without penalty and interest. Online and phone payments must be finished by 11:59 p.m. Central that day, and mailed payments postmarked by January 31.

Pay online any time, or by phone 24/7 at 817-884-1110 in English or Spanish. Online and phone card fees are 2.15% for credit cards and a flat $2.95 for debit cards (American Express, Discover, Mastercard, Visa). At a branch, credit cards cost 2.15% with a $2.50 minimum and debit cards $2.50; cash, checks and money orders are also accepted.
Mail payments to the Tax Assessor-Collector, P.O. Box 961018, Fort Worth, TX 76161-0018. Checks are cleared electronically and not returned.

help.title: Half payment and quarterly installments
paragraphs: Half Payment: pay the first half by November 30, marked as a half payment, and the second half by June 30, with no penalty or interest.
Quarterly installments: owners of a residence homestead with an over-65 or disability exemption can pay in four parts due January 31, March 31, May 31 and July 31.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Search for your account, pick PAPERLESS from the account options, agree to the terms and enter your email address. Under Texas law you then stop receiving tax bills and delinquent notices by mail.
Sign up by September 15 to get the year's first statement electronically; enrollment carries over to later years. To stop, open PAPERLESS on the account again and click UNSUBSCRIBE.

help.title: Do I need a profile?
paragraphs: No. The new payment portal lets anyone search by account number, owner name, mailing or property address, view account details and pay without logging in.

A TaxPayer Portal profile is optional. Log in with your email address and password, or continue with Google, Facebook or a Microsoft account; use Sign up to create one and Reset password if you forget it. Profiles moved over from the old system are asked to set a new password.

extra.intent: Using the Tarrant County Tax Office's website help pages, find the date by which the first half must be paid to use the Half Payment option. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: The first half must be paid by November 30, and the second half by June 30.

extra.intent: Using the Tarrant County Tax Office's website help pages, find the fee for paying property taxes online with a debit card. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Online debit card payments cost a flat $2.95; credit cards cost 2.15%.
